2026-08-13 RETRACTION: the preceding entry was WRONG and is retracted. LITNET-2020 tuning was NOT statistically void because of the paper or its config — it was void because THIS harness omitted scripts/interleave_litnet.py in both the EC2 bootstrap and the local Stage 0 build, leaving the stream as three contiguous attack-type blocks so validation/test were pure spam (6 and 132 attacks). The published LITNET evaluation is sound and uses a ~6.5% test slice (14,621 attacks in 225,000 rows), confirmed by in-memory reconstruction of the documented interleave and independently by the Table 12 ablation row (implies 6.54%, predicts FPR 0.0015 vs 0.001 reported) and the LOF precision bound (<=6.95%). The reallocation to CICIDS2017 was therefore made on a FALSE PREMISE; CICIDS tuning is itself valid, but LITNET tuning should not have been dropped. The 14 LITNET grid partials are void and quarantined under results/tuning_parts/void_litnet_uninterleaved/.
